feeds.title: alessandrina.com » Machine knitting
feeds.description: Hello! I am Alessandrina. I am interested in nearly all things fiber. My main focus is on machine knitting. I construct my wearable using a variety of on and off the loom techniques to produce one of a kind and limited edition items.

feeds.title: The Interior of My Brain » Machine Knitting
feeds.description: The Interior of My Brain is a knitting and fiber arts blog. Get to know everything about Machine Knitting techniques, style, fabrics and its different properties like color, texture, thickness and more.

feeds.title: Machine Knit Community Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with news, updates and articles about machine knitting and a community of online machine knitters. Our inclusive, supportive Community has a proven track record of taking members from beginners or frustrated machine knitters to focused, confident members knitting beautiful garments that they are proud to wear themselves or gift to their friends and family.

feeds.title: Olgalyn Jolly
feeds.description: Welcome to O! Jolly! Knitting in the Fastlane! This is the place where knit designer Olgalyn Jolly shares her knitting explorations on the Kniterate, the new digital knitting machine.

feeds.title: Knit It Now Blog
feeds.description: Master your knitting machine with to-the-point videos, courses and machine knitting patterns. Since 2010, machine knitters have relied on Knit it Now to be the premier source for all things machine knitting.

feeds.title: Vikki Haffenden » Machine Knitting
feeds.description: A website and blog about textiles (especially knitting), and other things. Find tutorials, tips, patterns and more! This blog covers many aspects of textiles, but its main focus is on knitting; both hand and machine. You will find discussions on Creative Machine Knitting along with instructions for using machines, machine accessories, repairs, tips and techniques. As the blog has grown it has embraced other aspects of textiles.

feeds.title: Myblueheavenknits's Blog
feeds.description: In 1995, I started my own Arts and Crafts business, Linda's Crafts, in an attempt to ease the stress of my challenging career. I have been doing craft shows on weekends in the Southern California area ever since and have branched off into machine Custom Knitting, designing my own patterns. Follow along as I share patterns, tutorials, philosophy and more!

feeds.title: Needles of Steel
feeds.description: A blog all about machine knitting, and various other craft exploits. I'm a knitter who was taught to knit when I was around 8 or 9. I am a design engineer, amateur photographer, crafter and occasional teacher of machine knitting.

feeds.title: Diana natters on... about machine knitting
feeds.description: I'm a lady CPA in Austin, Texas. I am an avid machine knitter and doing all I can to spread machine knitting joy.Get details on machine knitting, free patterns, videos, lessons, tips, and links.

feeds.title: Brunswick Machine Knitting Novices
feeds.description: We are a club of the Machine Knitters Association of Victoria with a mission to give novices a chance to try out the craft of machine knitting without needing to own a knitting machine.We like simple techniques and interesting fibres and design.We embrace both retro and contemporary style in knitted textiles.

feeds.title: Herman Hills Farm Blog
feeds.description: I design contemporary patterns for digital knitting machines and sell 3D-printed Passap replacement parts. Check my blog for machine knitting tutorials and patterns (with Designaknit and Wincrea files) for Passap and other electronic knitting machines.

feeds.title: Wicked Woollies Blog
feeds.description: Find blog posts on machine knitting on the wicked woollies blog. Beginners guide to machine knitting. I am Carol and live with my cat Jenson. Finding myself with time on my hands and needing a challenge, I decided to learn the old art of Machine Knitting.

feeds.title: Creative Tien Blog
feeds.description: I started my hand knitting, machine knitting, and sewing journey when I had my first baby, and learned mostly from the internet and books. There is not a lot of resources for machine knitting. This blog is a way to share everything I know. I am Tien. I have a background in interior design, lighting design, and Chinese medicine including acupuncture and herbs.

feeds.title: Kriskrafter
feeds.description: Browse through free Knitting Patterns, Crochet Patterns, and machine Knitting Patterns along with hints and tips.

feeds.title: ELY Knits Blog
feeds.description: I'm Emily! I'm a fiber artist, knitting instructor, machine knitter, and overall yarn fanatic. I'm passing on what I've learned to you in hopes you'll join me as I continue learning on this crazy, comfy, and colorful knitting journey. Join me here on the blog twice a month for tips, tricks, patterns, and reviews.

feeds.title: Ozlorna's Knitting Blog
feeds.description: Discover some unique patterns, machine knitting tips and tutorials, videos, inspiration and ideas and more!

feeds.title: Needles to say
feeds.description: Needles to say was designed to inspire, excite, educate and entertain. Check out machine knitting tutorials, information, tips and tricks for everyone from beginners to expert and more!

feeds.title: Infiniti Crafting Company Blog » Sentro Knitting Machine Tutorials
feeds.description: Here you will find a variety of knit, crochet, and artsy content. Similarly, I have a host of handmade items ready to find their forever homes. I am a crochet/knit designer and YouTuber with a vision to bring therapeutic maker content to the world. Explore my projects made on Sentro Knitting Machine, tutorials, tips and more!

feeds.title: Machine Knitting Monthly
feeds.description: Machine Knitting Monthly is the only monthly magazine in the world for machine knitters. Get the hand-knitted look in a fraction of the time.
